en: A black‑and‑white vintage postcard showing a street market scene. In the foreground an Indigenous woman in a dark veil sits on a chair beside a large basket or stall of goods, shaded by an open umbrella. Behind her are market tents, carts, and modest buildings, giving the impression of a busy outdoor bazaar. The edges of the card are scalloped and there is printed French text along the bottom margin.
